text:
Morgan: Heads up — saw several onprem tenants still holding superuser after the RoleBinding TTL passed. This is for a Dedicated/Private control plane tenant (acme-prod).
Dmitri: hmm. which binding exactly? link to logs?
Morgan: rolebinding: rb-acme-admin-ephemeral, created 2026-01-09 08:02, annotated ttl=3600, but last seen renew at 2026-01-09 09:15. should have expired at ~09:02.
Sarah: are you sure the controller that prunes expired RoleBindings ran? any controller errors?
Morgan: controller shows success, but server side audit shows token minted at 09:14 with 'kms-signature: ok'. suspicious.
Dmitri: can you paste the RoleBinding describe?
Morgan: ```
$ kubectl -n acme-system describe rolebinding rb-acme-admin-ephemeral
Name: rb-acme-admin-ephemeral
Labels: managed-by=ephemeral-authn
Annotations: ttl=3600
Subjects: ServiceAccount: acme-admin-sa
Role: cluster-admin (clusterrole)
Age: 1h13m
Events: <none>
```
Diego: age 1h13m matches the problem. If TTL=3600 (1h) it should have been removed. Could be clock skew between control plane and the ephemeral controller. Also possible KMS token re-signing extended the session.
OpsBot: Automated alert: detected rolebinding TTL mismatch for acme-prod (severity: medium). Ticket created: SEC-1421.
Sarah: Ok next steps: 1) reproduce locally for the onprem control plane with a shorter TTL, 2) check controller logs around creation/expiry, 3) verify KMS TTL/nonce behavior — does remote KMS re-signing implicitly extend sessions?
Dmitri: quick check — audit log excerpt shows two operations: "create token" at 09:02, then "re-sign token" at 09:14 by kms-proxy. That re-signing step is likely renewing the ephemeral credential rather than the binding itself, but our authz code treats any valid token as active even if the binding should have been pruned.
Morgan: so bug is 'binding pruning' vs 'token validation' mismatch: pruning relies on created_at + ttl, token validation looks at token signature only. If KMS re-signs a token containing an earlier issued_at, the token still validates but the binding should not exist.
Diego: proposed fixes: A) enforce token->binding mapping check at authz time (reject token if binding expired), B) change controller to use absolute expiry annotation with unix epoch, not relative ttl, C) patch kms-proxy to not re-sign tokens or to propagate original issued_at in signed payload.
Sarah: preferred order: quick mitigation (A) then controller fix (B) for correctness. KMS change (C) needs vendor/infra approval.
Dmitri: for mitigation A add check in authn filter: lookup binding and compare expiry_unix > now. If missing or expired then reject even if token signature valid. I can do a small patch.
Morgan: ack. Also need for private control plane we might have VPC NAT time sync issues. Diego, can infra check NTP drift on the bastions/controlplane nodes for acme-prod?
Diego: I'll run a drift report across the cluster and control plane in the morning and share results here.
Sarah: create a temporary alert rule to fire if any ephemeral binding age > ttl + 5m, we can detect drifting ones quickly.
OpsBot: Created alert rule: ephemerals/ttl-exceeded (threshold: ttl + 5m) — will page on next occurrence.
Morgan: test plan outline: 1) Dmitri implements token->binding check and deploy to staging, 2) create test binding with ttl=30s, attempt re-sign flow, verify access denied after ttl, 3) run drift simulation (offset clocks) to ensure behavior consistent, 4) roll to prod after 48h monitoring.
Dmitri: picking up SEC-1421. I'll open PR for authn filter change and mark WIP.
Sarah: also add an entry to compliance audit notes: if token re-signing can extend effective access without binding present, that's a compliance risk for private tenants. We'll need to document mitigation and timeline.
Morgan: Agreed. Diego, after drift check can you also validate KMS proxy config to ensure it forwards issued_at in the signed payload? If not, we escalate to KMS infra.
Diego: will do.
Morgan: thanks everyone. small follow-ups: Dmitri assign reviewers, Sarah add compliance blurb to SEC-1421, Diego post drift report here when ready. :thumbsup:
Diego: noted.
Dmitri: starting patch now.
Sarah: Thanks — keep updates brief here.
Morgan: closing loop when PR merged and alert firing stops. :lock:
